comparison_policy: source cases are not rankable until feedstock, accepted product, measurement, and system boundaries are matched

reported_observations: OES reports oxygen-containing and CO-related signatures in the respective source cases
XPS identifies fluorine on processed surfaces
The article describes an initial qualitative experimental demonstration

complete gas composition and recovery balance
fluorine inventory and recycle efficiency
grid-to-product energy per accepted O2
product purity and storage qualification
industrial lifetime or lunar operational qualification

records.title: Impact of oxygen extraction from lunar regolith simulant using fluorinated plasma processes
reported_observations: The article reports measurable O2, CO and CO2 gas extraction observations

A fluoride surface layer and associated XRD / EDS changes are reported
C4F8 shows a different reaction pattern and is not restricted to the same mineral component

full reagent and residue inventory closure
grid-to-product energy per accepted O2

records.title: Vacuum-induced oxygen extraction from Fe-bearing model minerals: implications for lunar regolith processing
reported_observations: Ground-based experiments verified oxygen gas emission from iron-bearing model minerals under low pressure
A 1 g hematite pellet was fully reduced to magnetite and 0.03 g oxygen was removed at 1200 C and 1e-8 atm total pressure
The paper thermodynamically predicts oxygen release from model lunar regolith composition at 1050–1300 C and 1e-15 atm through SiO2 and FeO reduction
not_established_by_source_summary: oxygen yield from a lunar regolith simulant in the physical experiment
accepted purified O2 product rate or purity
complete grid-side energy and auxiliary boundary
process throughput, equipment lifetime or lunar operating performance
records.claim_ceiling: model-mineral proof-of-concept plus thermodynamic regolith prediction; not a physical regolith-simulant process benchmark

records.title: From extraction to purification: A comprehensive review of oxygen production from lunar regolith for ISRU
reported_observations: Reviews eight representative oxygen extraction methods including fluorination and molten regolith electrolysis
Reviews downstream high-purity oxygen approaches including cryogenic distillation, pressure swing adsorption, membranes and electrochemical oxygen pumps
Frames oxygen production as extraction plus purification and lunar supply integration
not_established_by_source_summary: new physical performance data for a specific process
matched system energy or cost ranking across extraction routes
qualification of any one purification chain for a specific lunar plant
records.claim_ceiling: technology review and process-chain synthesis; not a new experimental performance point
